author: reek
body: The side query, against the real thing. The fixture below is the verbatim content of `annotations/codex/Emit/PeWriter.json` as it sits in the depot, not a shape invented to suit the parser. That is the point: the sidecar format is a claim made in `annotations/README.md`, the parser is a separate claim in `AnnotationsSidecar`, and nothing had ever put the two together. One of the five depot sidecars is a bare object where the README specifies an array, which no reader would have survived and no test could have seen.

author: reek
body: The path assertion is here for the same reason. `sidecar-path-for` built `codex.annotations/...` while the directory on disk has always been `annotations/`, and the only caller was a test supplying its own fixture, so the two never met.
